title: Sheldrake's plant research at an agricultural institute in India

tellings.quote: I spent years in India working in an agricultural Research Institute on um breeding chick better chick peas and pigeon peas

plain: A scientist named Rupert Sheldrake tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he spent years in India working at an agricultural research institute. He says his job there was breeding better chickpeas and pigeon peas, two food crops. He brings it up as part of his background as a working plant scientist, before the ideas that made him controversial.
